+import AlgebraicJacobian.Albanese.SymPowInterface
+
+open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
+
+universe v u
+variable {K : Type u} [Category.{v} K] [CartesianMonoidalCategory K] [HasFiniteProducts K]
+
+/-- ADVERSARIAL 1: identity inhabits SymPowData for EVERY n. -/
+noncomputable def symPowDataTrivial (C : K) (n : ℕ) : SymPowData C n where
+  carrier := ∏ᶜ (fun _ : Fin n => C)
+  proj := 𝟙 _
+  desc := fun {T} h _ => ⟨h, by simp, fun u hu => by simpa using hu⟩
+
+/-- ADVERSARIAL 2: is there an `hproj` witness for symPowDataOne? -/
+example (C : K) : ∀ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 1),
+    MonObj.permAut C σ ≫ (symPowDataOne C).proj = (symPowDataOne C).proj := by
+  intro σ
+  show MonObj.permAut C σ ≫ Pi.π (fun _ : Fin 1 => C) 0 = Pi.π (fun _ : Fin 1 => C) 0
+  rw [MonObj.permAut_π]
+  congr 1
+  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
+
+/-- ADVERSARIAL 3: does `hproj` hold for the TRIVIAL datum at n = 2?
+If provable, the trivial datum satisfies the full hypothesis set and everything
+downstream is vacuously about C^n. -/
+example (C : K) : ∀ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 2),
+    MonObj.permAut C σ ≫ (symPowDataTrivial C 2).proj = (symPowDataTrivial C 2).proj := by
+  intro σ
+  show MonObj.permAut C σ ≫ 𝟙 _ = 𝟙 _
+  sorry
